dish.title: Pan-Seared Halibut with Lemon Butter and Sweet Corn Saute
dish.description: A 25-minute summer plate: thick halibut fillets seared golden and basted in garlicky lemon butter, served over a quick saute of sweet corn, cherry tomatoes, and scallions with torn basil.

recipe_version.immutability_note: v2 supersedes v1. Doneness instruction only. kitchen_tested is false. Not a household rating.
recipe_version.title: Pan-Seared Halibut with Lemon Butter and Sweet Corn Saute
recipe_version.description: A 25-minute summer plate: thick halibut fillets seared golden and basted in garlicky lemon butter, served over a quick saute of sweet corn, cherry tomatoes, and scallions with torn basil.

ingredients.name: halibut fillets
ingredients.display_name: 6-oz skinless halibut fillets, about 1 inch thick

ingredients.name: lemon
ingredients.preparation: half juiced, half cut into wedges

ingredients.name: corn kernels
ingredients.display_name: corn kernels (from 4 ears or frozen, thawed)

steps.title: Prep
steps.body: Pat the halibut very dry and season with 1 tsp salt and the pepper. Halve the tomatoes, slice the scallions, smash the garlic, and juice half the lemon.

steps.title: Saute the corn
steps.body: Heat the olive oil in the 10-inch skillet over medium-high. Cook the corn and scallions until lightly browned, 4 minutes, add the tomatoes and 1/2 tsp salt for 2 minutes, and move off the heat.

steps.title: Sear the halibut
steps.body: Heat the neutral oil in the 12-inch skillet over medium-high until shimmering. Sear the fillets without moving until golden, 4 minutes, then flip.

steps.title: Baste with lemon butter
steps.body: Lower to medium, add the butter and garlic, and spoon the foaming butter over the fish until opaque at the center and 145 F, 4 minutes. Add the lemon juice. Optional traditional preparation: just opaque at 130 F to 135 F after about 3 minutes. That lower temperature does not meet the USDA/FDA recommendation and carries higher risk, especially for young children, pregnant people, older adults, and anyone immunocompromised.

steps.title: Serve
steps.body: Spoon the corn onto plates, top with the halibut and pan butter, and scatter with basil. Serve with lemon wedges.
